title: Director, Data Center Contracts & Commercial Strategy
description:

Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

title: Solar Asset Project Manager (Contract-to-Hire)
description:
Our client is one of North America's largest integrated decarbonization-as-a-service providers, delivering accessible, reliable renewable energy solutions that support a zero-emissions future. With over 1,300 MW of distributed energy resources in operation across 28 states, the company serves more than 1,000 customers across the education, commercial, industrial, municipal, and utility sectors. Their offerings include on and off-site solar, energy storage, and EV infrastructure.

The **Solar Asset Project Manager** will lead field projects across an operating solar portfolio, overseeing scope, schedule, budget, contractor management, and project execution from initiation through closeout. Projects may include repowers, remediation efforts, asset upgrades, removal and reinstall activities, and decommissioning projects.

This role is structured as a contract-to-hire opportunity, with an anticipated transition to a full-time position after approximately six months.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead projects from initiation through closeout, ensuring safe execution, budget adherence, and schedule compliance.
* Review project intake documentation and technical requirements to validate scope and establish execution plans.
* Develop project schedules, scopes of work, budgets, and resource plans.
* Coordinate project activities with Asset Management, Engineering, Customer Care, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and external contractors.
* Manage site logistics, contractor mobilization, access requirements, and field execution activities.
* Lead project meetings and provide regular status updates to stakeholders.
* Oversee contractor procurement efforts, including bid evaluations, scope alignment, and vendor performance management.
* Review and manage change orders, project risks, and schedule impacts throughout execution.
